prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['pick_friend_grid_layout_redesign']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['defer_sign_in_after_adoption', 'photo_upload_guidelines_flow', 'home_intro_desktop_visibility_check', 'pet_shortcut_guide_screen', 'sign_in_card_layout_redesign', 'pet_personality_quiz_flow', 'finish_desktop_display_troubleshooter_screen', 'pick_friend_carousel_redesign', 'photo_upload_quality_guidance_flow', 'sign_in_split_account_restoration_redesign', 'new_pet_care_tips_screen']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['pet_controls_quick_guide', 'live_pet_preview_adoption', 'welcome_pet_bonus_badge', 'choose_path_grid_cards', 'adoption_certificate_stage_redesign', 'desktop_pet_controls_onboarding', 'sign_in_account_sync_notice', 'photo_upload_preview_verification', 'adoption_trait_customization_flow', 'sign_in_reorder_early', 'adoption_starter_incentive', 'pick_friend_split_selection_redesign', 'home_intro_command_cheatsheet_screen', 'choose_path_preview_flow', 'home_intro_desktop_launch_redesign', 'path_selection_before_story_reorder', 'certificate_naming_incentive', 'sign_in_account_persistence_warning', 'home_intro_split_interactive_redesign', 'adoption_certificate_two_column_redesign', 'pick_friend_starter_accessory_incentive', 'adoption_certificate_signoff_flow', 'sign_in_account_restoration_hint', 'home_intro_desktop_interaction_guide', 'adoption_certificate_badge_redesign', 'sign_in_troubleshoot_notification', 'choose_path_story_scroll_redesign', 'upload_photos_quality_checklist_hint', 'choose_path_starter_perks_notice']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
'adoption, redesign' changes have shown helpful, positive results after noise correction across 2 tests, backed by a winning test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, and 13 were underestimated.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: pick_friend_two_column_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a two-column layout featuring an expanded live preview on the left and pet choice cards on the right.
candidates.why: Lessons show that adoption redesigns consistently yield positive conversion gains, and adoption is currently a major funnel drop-off at 68.4%.

candidates.title: home_intro_spotlight_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the finish onboarding screen into a spotlight layout that highlights essential controls and desktop pet interaction steps.
candidates.why: Finish screen drop-off is high (64.8% conversion) with a mean time of 5815s, and support logs show confusion on controlling or finding the pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is active on your screen. Click and drag your pet or check the system tray to manage pet settings.

home_welcome.text: Click your pet directly on the desktop to interact or hide it anytime.

candidates.title: new_waiting_progress_companion_screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated waiting companion screen that displays an animated preparation process while the desktop pet is generated.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs while assets load.

new_waiting_companion.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space
new_waiting_companion.body: We are getting your companion ready to jump onto your desktop.

candidates.title: sign_in_reorder_after_adoption
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so that sign-in happens after pet adoption selection instead of before.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users before they get to choose a pet, creating unnecessary early friction.

candidates.title: upload_photos_file_format_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo formatting hint to the photo upload screen explaining lighting and background requirements.
candidates.why: Support logs show 3 user reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Use a clear, well-lit image (JPG or PNG) with good contrast for best custom pet results.

candidates.title: waiting_time_estimate_display
candidates.change: Display a visible step counter and estimated time remaining during the pet creation waiting phase.
candidates.why: Users spend up to 2336s on average on the waiting step without feedback on how long rendering will take.

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Rendering custom pet animations. This usually takes about 2 minutes.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_visibility_copy
candidates.change: Update final screen headlines and text to explicitly explain where the pet appears on the desktop and taskbar.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or users being unable to open the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop or system tray icon. Click on your pet at any time to interact or open pet settings.

candidates.title: waiting_ready_desktop_notification
candidates.change: Enable optional system notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet setup completes.
candidates.why: High average waiting times cause users to switch away to other apps and drop off before finishing.

waiting.hint: We will send a system notification as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

candidates.title: choose_path_starter_bonus_badge
candidates.change: Add a prominent starter bonus badge on the path selection screen highlighting instant companion perk unlocks.
candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users immediately on launch with a long mean duration of 514s.

candidates.title: sign_in_compact_layout_view
candidates.change: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout emphasizing account continuity and existing user account syncing.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different or duplicate account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Please use your primary login to ensure all your pets and unlocked accessories stay connected.
